title: Mako Mermaids Mod
description: Live your H2O dream! Play as Cleo, Emma, Rikki or Mako characters, use elemental powers, and create your own story!
body:
# 🌊 Mako Mermaids — Minecraft Mod ### Dive into the world of H2O: Just Add Water & Mako Mermaids 🎬 **New Showcase Video:** https://youtu.be/CBbTB6Kdxq4?si=TtKh-MFCiTDvmnrL
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join_Server-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/uv4sttKEw3) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-Visit-0099cc?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://makomoddev.github.io/mako-mermaids-mod-official/) [![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube-Showcase-FF0000?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://youtu.be/CBbTB6Kdxq4)
--- > [!WARNING] > This is an **unofficial fan-made project** based on the TV shows *H2O: Just Add Water* and *Mako Mermaids*. I am not affiliated with Jonathan M. Shiff Productions or any other rights holders. All rights to the original shows, characters, and content belong to their respective owners. This mod is created **purely for entertainment purposes** and is completely **free to use**. ---
### 🧜 Playable Characters Choose your favourite character from *Mako Mermaids* or *H2O: Just Add Water* when first entering a world via an interactive GUI selection screen. `Cleo` · `Emma` · `Rikki` · `Bella` · `Charlotte` · `Nixie` · `Lyla` · `Sirena` · `Mimmi` · `Ondina` · `Weilan` · `Zac` · `Cam` · `Evie`
---
### 📜 Commands | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `/change_character` | Switch to a different character | | `/what_character` | Display your currently selected character |
---
### ⚡ Abilities > **Always make sure you are on the latest available version!**
* 🌊 Transform into a mermaid when underwater, in rain, or exposed to Moon Water *(rain disables positive status effects)* * 💨 Swim faster underwater — hold `C` while swimming * 🌕 See the current moon phase by right-clicking on a bed * 🐢 As a mermaid on land, you move slowly and need to "melt" back into human form *(not possible in cold biomes)* * ⏳ After drying off, a **"Drying..."** progress bar is displayed on screen during the 5-second transformation back to human form * 🏆 Unlock many new **achievements**
🌕 Moon Events
**Rikki** sets nearby things on fire during a full moon *(she gains fire resistance during this time)*
🐉 Water Dragon
- The Water Dragon has a **custom pixel-art boss health bar** displayed on screen - Getting hit **once** removes your mermaid form - Hit as a **half-mermaid** → powers removed · Hit as a **full mermaid** → instant death - **Turn the Tide** *(Zac & Weilan — `B` key)*: 5 seconds of immunity against the Water Dragon
---
### 🔮 Elemental Powers > All keybinds can be customised in the game's Settings menu. | Power | Characters | Keybind | | :--- | :--- | :---: | | Ice → Water | Cleo, Charlotte, Mako | `↓ Down` | | Water → Ice | Emma, Charlotte, Mako | `↑ Up` | | Place Snow | Emma, Charlotte | `↑ Up` | | Ice → Air | Cleo, Charlotte, Mako | `X` | | Water → Air | Rikki, Charlotte, Mako | `→ Right` | | Water → Jelly | Bella | `↑ Up` | | Create Thunderstorm | Ondina, Sirena | `U` | | Turn Invisible | Mako characters only | `R` | | Levitate Entities | Mako characters only | `G` | | Hydrokinesis | Mako with Moon Ring, Cleo | `G` | | Pull Items | Mako characters only | `← Left` |
---
### 🤲 Gesture Controls Some abilities can be activated using **hand gestures** — [Gesture tutorial & required files](https://makomoddev.github.io/mako-mermaids-mod-official/downloads) | Gesture | Power | Characters | | :---: | :--- | :--- | | ✋ Open Hand | Freezing / Jelly | Emma (& Mako) / Bella | | ✊ Fist | Melting / Boiling | Rikki & Mako | | ☝️ One Finger | Levitation | Mako characters |
---
### 🌍 Biomes & Structures | Location | Description | | :--- | :--- | | 🌊 **Beaufort Sea** | New ocean biome | | 🌊 **Baltic Sea** | New ocean biome | | 🌑 **Moon Pool** | Spawns rarely underground near beaches — the **only place** to find Moon Crystal Ore! |
---
### 🏥 Additional Features
* **Mermaid Cold** — Cold biomes inflict you with the mermaid cold. Cure it using **Seahorse Powder**, obtainable from the Ocean Café Shop. * **Transformation Drinks** — Coconut Smoothie, Juice, or Smoothie transforms you into a mermaid after **10 seconds**. * **Open doors** from a greater distance than normal. * **Custom Main Menu** and blue-themed GUI * **Wiki available in-game** ---
### 🎁 New Items
📦 Show full item list
| Item | Description | | :--- | :--- | | 🌙 **Moon Ring** `(K)` | Powers: Size Manipulation, Hydrokinesis, Item Duplication & turning mobs into cats — *Mako characters only* | | 🔱 **Moon Trident** | Crafted from a Trident + Moon Crystal — fires a powerful **magic beam attack** | | ☕ **Ocean Café Menu** | Plays a cutscene, then lets you trade with David, Carly, Cam & Evie *(they accept seashells for smoothies, etc.)* | | 📼 **Intro Block** | Plays the *H2O: Just Add Water* intro | | 🐚 **Seahorse Powder** | Cures the mermaid cold — *Mako characters only (except Mimmi)* | | 🌿 **Arctic Sea Lavender** | Crafting ingredient | | 🦪 **Foul Smelling Oysters** | Crafting ingredient | | 🌊 **Dried Plankton of the Baltic Sea** | Crafting ingredient | | ❄️ **Arctic Marshmallow** | Crafted from the 3 ingredients above + a Water Bucket | | 🐬 **Glass Dolphin** | Collectible decorative item | | 💀 **Broken Glass Dolphin** | Damaged variant of the Glass Dolphin | | 🛡️ **OP Armor** | Powerful armor set | | 🐚 **Seashell** | Currency for the Ocean Café — also found by **brushing Suspicious Sand**! | | 🪢 **Rope** | Crafted from 4 Strings | | 📿 **Seashell Bracelet** | Crafted from 4 Seashells + 4 Ropes | | 💎 **Moon Crystal Ore** | Very rare and hard to mine — drops **Moon Crystals** | | 💎 **Moon Crystal** | Combine with a Trident to craft the **Moon Trident** | | 📿 **Moon Crystal Necklace** | Crafted from 7 Ropes + 1 Moon Crystal | | 🧺 **Towel** | Crafted from 3 wool blocks (any color) — hold for **5 seconds** (XP bar acts as countdown) to revert to human form *(does not work in cold biomes)* | | 🚤 **Speed Boat** | Crafted like a normal boat, but using Iron | | 🧃 **Juice** | Bottle + Apple + Carrot → Transforms you into a mermaid after 10 seconds | | 🥥 **Coconut Smoothie** | Transforms you into a mermaid after 10 seconds | | 🫐 **Smoothie** | Bottle + Sweet Berries → Transforms you into a mermaid after 10 seconds | | 🟦 **Jelly Block** | Created by Bella's power | | 💧 **Moon Water** | Cam gains swimming speed on contact — removed by heat power or a Towel |
